predecessors.name: Principality of Kiev
predecessors.text: the Turov-Pinsk land, which Cliopatria draws inside the Kiev principality until 1187 (295 of its 297 cells)

successors.name: Principality of Turov
successors.text: Turov and Haradok, still ruled by Rurikids when the principality joined Lithuania

successors.name: Principality of Pinsk
successors.text: Pinsk, where Hleb Narymunt, a son of Gediminas, ruled when the lands joined the Grand Duchy

ledger.x: 1188: Turov-Pinsk appears as its own principality in Cliopatria's map.
1293: the single Turov-Pinsk principality gives way to the two principalities of Turov and Pinsk that Cliopatria draws from 1294.

wars.name: Battle of the Kalka River
wars.outcome: 'Along with the Principality of Smolensk, the army of Turau participated' (Turov page); the Mongol invasion page has the Mongols defeat the united Rus' army at the Kalka on 31 May 1223.

wars.name: Mongol invasion of Kievan Rus'
wars.outcome: Mongol victory; the infobox lists Turov and Pinsk among the belligerents and says the Rus' principalities became Mongol vassals; the page dates no event in Turov, so no zone is drawn.

certainty.note: No page gives a boundary of Turov or Pinsk; the Pripyat marsh frontiers with Minsk, Drutsk, Kiev, Volhynia and Brest are approximate throughout.
